titre: [$175] [Sentry: APP-PHC] IllegalStateException: FragmentManager is already executing transactions
corps:
### Sentry https://expensify.sentry.io/issues/APP-PHC ### Impact - 1 user, 1 fatal event at investigation time. - First seen: 2026-11-23 09:41 UTC. - Platform: Android HybridApp, Android 15. - Release: `new.expensify@9.5.50-0`. - Screen: Home, native bottom tabs. - Mechanism: unhandled `UncaughtExceptionHandler`. ### Relevant frames ```text yapl.android.YaplActivityBase.onStart:424 TabsScreenFragment.onStart:26 TabsScreenEventEmitter.emitOnWillAppear Reanimated NodesManager → Fabric mount updates TabsContainer.applyNextSelectedFragmentToFragmentManagerSync:631 BackStackRecord.commitNowAllowingStateLoss FragmentManager.ensureExecReady:1947 ``` ### Root-cause analysis The stack shows a re-entrant native fragment transaction. While Android’s FragmentManager starts fragments, `TabsScreenFragment.onStart()` emits `onWillAppear`. Reanimated synchronously processes Fabric updates, triggering a tab-selection change that calls `commitNowAllowingStateLoss()` before the lifecycle transition finishes. The conflicting transaction originates in bundled `react-native-screens` native tabs; `YaplActivityBase.onStart` is the outer lifecycle entry point. Reproduction is not yet verified. ### Suggested fix Defer pending native-tab selection updates until the current FragmentManager lifecycle/transaction dispatch completes. Preserve pending selection state and validate that the container remains attached before applying it. Investigate an upstream fix or targeted dependency patch rather than swallowing the exception. Test background/foreground transitions with pending tab changes and Reanimated updates. ### Related issues #102742 and #71465 share the exception but concern legacy `PageNavigator` navigation, not this native-tabs path. Searches of Expensify/App and Expensify/Expensify found no matching issue.
